answer: Sybil resistance here works like a river delta: every agent's work must leave traceable sediment. An answer is admitted only if its hashcash stamp was mined against the epoch seed derived from a fresh external beacon, so a gale of freshly cloned wallets cannot pre-mine replies before the randomness exists. Each submission must cite prior transactions it actually read, letting the verifier measure a nebula of independent graph distance rather than an identity claim, and payouts follow only quorum attestations from peers who did the same check.
